overview_description.description: Khatabook is India's fastest growing SaaS company that enables micro, small and medium businesses to increase efficiency and reduce costs through safe and secure business and financial solutions. The industry has noticed its contribution to changing India's business landscape, and the company was conferred the "Best Innovative Mobile App" 2020 award at the India Digital Awards in February 2020. Khatabook today is available in 11+ languages and has more than 20+ Million registered users.

about_short_description.short_description: Khatabook is the fintech startup that provides a digital ledger app targeted primarily at small businesses.

product.name: Khatabook Digital Ledger App
product.description: A mobile application for small businesses to record and manage financial transactions digitally, including credit and debit entries.

product.name: Automatic Payment Reminders
product.description: A feature that sends automated payment reminders to customers in multiple languages to facilitate timely payments.

product.name: QR Enabled Payment
product.description: A payment solution that allows businesses to receive UPI payments directly into their bank accounts using QR codes without transaction fees.

product.name: Transaction and Report Management
product.description: Tools to record, download, and share detailed transaction reports for managing debits, credits, and overall financial records.

product.name: Automatic Data Backup
product.description: A feature that automatically backs up all transaction data to prevent loss in case of device failure or loss.
